prerequisites.wiki_text: Orders From Drakuru

records.name: The Exiles of Ulduar
records.objectives_text: Speak with Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

records.name: The Drakkensryd
records.objectives_text: Use the Hyldnir Harpoon to defeat 10 Hyldsmeet Drakeriders at the Temple of Storms. Use the Hyldnir Harpoon on a Column Ornament to exit the Drakkensryd and speak to Thorim when you've succeeded.

records.name: It's All Fun and Games
records.objectives_text: Destroy The Ocular and then report to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.

records.name: SCRAP-E
records.objectives_text: Bring the SCRAP-E Access Card along with 4 Handfuls of Cobalt Bolts and 5 Overcharged Capacitors to SCRAP-E at The Inventor's Library.

records.name: The Prototype Console
records.objectives_text: Interact with the Prototype Console in The Inventor's Library.

prerequisites.wiki_text: SCRAP-E

records.name: I Have an Idea, But First...
records.objectives_text: Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault has asked you to collect a Cultist Rod, an Abomination Hook, a Geist Rope, and 5 Scourge Essences.

prerequisites.wiki_text: It's All Fun and Games

wiki.page: I Have an Idea, But First...

records.name: It's All Fun and Games
records.objectives_text: Destroy The Ocular and then report to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.

records.name: Free Your Mind
records.objectives_text: Baron Sliver at the Shadow Vault wants you to use the Sovereign Rod on the corpses of Vile, Lady Nightswood, and The Leaper.

records.name: Crusader Forward Camp
records.objectives_text: Seek out Crusader MacKellar at the Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak.

records.name: The Missing Bronzebeard
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Burlap-Wrapped Note from Brann's camp and return it to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.

records.name: If He Cannot Be Turned
records.objectives_text: Defeat General Lightsbane and then report your success back to Thassarian aboard the gunship, The Skybreaker.

records.name: If He Cannot Be Turned
records.objectives_text: Defeat General Lightsbane and then report your success back to Koltira Deathweaver aboard the gunship, Orgrim's Hammer.

records.name: The Shadow Vault
records.objectives_text: Report back to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.

records.name: The Shadow Vault
records.objectives_text: Report back to Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.

records.name: Making a Harness
records.objectives_text: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to obtain 3 Icemane Yeti Hides.

records.name: Making Something Out Of Nothing
records.objectives_text: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak has asked that you recover 10 pieces of Scourge Scrap Metal.

records.name: In Search Of Answers
records.objectives_text: Search Rageclaw Den for a clue about who or what initiated the attacks against the Rageclaw Wolvar.

records.name: That's What Friends Are For...
records.objectives_text: Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp has asked that you find Crusader Dargath, Gerk and Burr.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Crusader Forward Camp

records.name: Light Won't Grant Me Vengeance
records.objectives_text: Gerk at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak wants you to kill 15 Vargul.

records.name: Mildred the Cruel
records.objectives_text: Speak to Mildred the Cruel inside the Forlorn Mine.

records.name: Discipline
records.objectives_text: Mildred the Cruel at the Forlorn Mine wants you to use the Disciplining Rod on 6 Exhausted Vrykul.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Mildred the Cruel

records.name: Examples to be Made
records.objectives_text: Mildred the Cruel at the Forlorn Mine wants you to slay Garhal.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Discipline

records.name: A Certain Prisoner
records.objectives_text: Take Mildred's Key to Lok'lira the Crone in the Forlorn Mine.

records.name: The Nose Knows
records.objectives_text: Speak with Khaliisi at the foot of the mountain east of the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.

records.name: Sniffing Out the Perpetrator
records.objectives_text: Mount Frostbite and ride her to the source of the scent from Brann's note. Then, recover Brann's Communicator and use it to make contact with Brann Bronzebeard.

records.name: A Great Storm Approaches
records.objectives_text: Gymer, King of Storm Giants, has asked you to find a way to release him from his cage. Speak with Engineer Reed at the Crusader Forward Camp.

records.name: Speak Orcish, Man!
records.objectives_text: Speak with Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.

records.name: Gymer's Salvation
records.objectives_text: Engineer Reed at Crusader Forward Camp in Zul'Drak wants you to bring him 6 Banshee Essence and 6 Diatomaceous Earth.

records.name: Mending Fences
records.objectives_text: Thorim at the Temple of Storms wants you to Kill Fjorn and 5 Stormforged Iron Giants at Fjorn's Anvil, east of Dun Niffelem. Using Thorim's Charm of Earth will summon his Earthen to fight by your side. The charm requires a Granite Boulder from nearby Fjorn's Anvil.

records.name: Our Only Hope
records.objectives_text: Speak to Gymer at Thrym's End in Zul'Drak once you have used the Jumbo Seaforium Charge to open the Scourge Enclosure that is holding him prisoner.

records.name: Speaking with the Wind's Voice
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Voices of the Wind to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.

records.name: The Storm King's Vengeance
records.objectives_text: Speak with Gymer to begin. While riding Gymer, destroy 100 Scourge and kill Algar the Chosen, Thrym and Prince Navarius. Report to Crusader MacKellar at Crusader Forward Camp should you succeed.

records.name: Catching up with Brann
records.objectives_text: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard and speak with him, then speak to Boktar Bloodfury at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site. If you lose Brann's Communicator, speak with Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site.

records.name: A Change of Scenery
records.objectives_text: Reconvene with Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village.

records.name: The Refiner's Fire
records.objectives_text: You must collect 10 Furious Sparks from the Seething Revenants at Frostfield Lake and then use the anvil at Fjorn's Anvil.

records.name: Forging an Alliance
records.objectives_text: You are to go to Dun Niffelem and ask King Jokkum to allow Thorim's armor to be reforged. After completing Jokkum's task, you are to speak with Njormeld in Dun Niffelem.

objectives.text: Fjorn's Anvil Brought to Dun Niffelem

records.name: Aberrations
records.objectives_text: Thyra Kvinnshal in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and obtain Vial of Frost Oil from the Valkyrion Aspirants. Use the Vials of Frost Oil to destroy 30 Plagued Proto-Drake Eggs.

records.name: Pieces of the Puzzle
records.objectives_text: Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard and find out what to do next. Once you have completed Brann's instructions, use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard. If you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

records.name: Data Mining
records.objectives_text: Use the Inventor's Disk to retrieve 7 pieces of Hidden Data from the Databanks. Use Brann's Communicator to contact Brann Bronzebeard once you've completed this task. If you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

records.name: Norgannon's Shell
records.objectives_text: Recover Norgannon's Shell from Archivist Mechaton. Contact Brann Bronzebeard with :Brann's Communicator once you've accomplished this. If you lose Brann's Communicator, speak to Moteha Windborn at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site to replace it.

records.name: The Earthen of Ulduar
records.objectives_text: Speak with Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

records.name: Rare Earth
records.objectives_text: Use the Earthen Mining Pick to mine 7 clumps of Enchanted Earth. Bring the earth and 5 Frostweave cloth to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

prerequisites.wiki_text: The Earthen of Ulduar The Exiles of Ulduar

records.name: Fighting Back
records.objectives_text: Bouldercrag the Rockshaper wants you to slay 10 Stormforged Attackers and return to him at Bouldercrag's Refuge. You may kill either Stormforged Raiders or Stormforged Reavers.

records.name: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Magnataur!
records.objectives_text: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Stinkbeard! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

records.name: The Amphitheater of Anguish: From Beyond!
records.objectives_text: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat one of the elemental lords! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

wiki.page: The Amphitheater of Anguish: From Beyond!

records.name: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Tuskarrmageddon!
records.objectives_text: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Orinoko Tuskbreaker! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

records.name: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Korrak the Bloodrager!
records.objectives_text: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Korrak the Bloodrager! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

wiki.page: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Korrak the Bloodrager!

records.name: Relief for the Fallen
records.objectives_text: Use the Telluric Poultice to heal 8 Fallen Earthen Defenders, then return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

records.name: The Duke
records.objectives_text: Speak with Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault.

prerequisites.wiki_text: The Shadow Vault (quest)

records.name: Honor Challenge
records.objectives_text: Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault has asked you to use the Challenge Flag to challenge and defeat 6 Mjordin Combatants.

records.name: Off With Their Black Wings
records.objectives_text: Iva the Vengeful in Brunnhildar Village wants you to go to Valkyrion and slay 12 Nascent Val'lkyr.

records.name: Shadow Vault Decree
records.objectives_text: Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault has ordered you to read the Shadow Vault Decree in the presence of Thane Ufrang the Mighty, and then to slay him.

records.name: The Champion of Anguish
records.objectives_text: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Vladof the Butcher! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

records.name: Get the Key
records.objectives_text: Vaelen the Flayed at Ufrang's Hall has asked you to retrieve the Key to Vaelen's Chains.

records.name: Let the Baron Know
records.objectives_text: Speak with Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault.

records.name: Valkyrion Must Burn
records.objectives_text: Use the Valkyrion Harpoon Guns to burn 6 Dry Haystacks.

records.name: The Amphitheater of Anguish: Yggdras!
records.objectives_text: Get in the arena at the Amphitheater of Anguish and defeat Yggdras! Return to Wodin the Troll-Servant to redeem your reward.

records.name: Eliminate the Competition
records.objectives_text: The Leaper at The Shadow Vault wants you to duel and defeat Sigrid Iceborn, Efrem the Faithful, Onu'zun and Tinky Wickwhistle.

records.name: A Spark of Hope
records.objectives_text: You are to bring the Refined Gleaming Ore to Thorim in the Temple of Storms.

records.name: Slaves of the Stormforged
records.objectives_text: Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to free 6 Captive Mechagnomes and kill 3 Stormforged Taskmasters.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Relief for the Fallen & Fighting Back

records.name: Shipment: Blood Jade Amulet
records.objectives_text: Combine a Vrykul Amulet, a Dark Jade and a Bloodstone to make a Blood Jade Amulet and bring it to Timothy Jones in Dalaran. You can find a Vrykul Amulet on any Northrend Vrykul.

records.name: Shipment: Glowing Ivory Figurine
records.objectives_text: Combine a Northern Ivory, a Chalcedony and a Shadow Crystal to craft a :Glowing Ivory Figurine and bring it to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.

records.name: Shipment: Wicked Sun Brooch
records.objectives_text: Combine an Iron Dwarf Brooch, a :Huge Citrine and a :Sun Crystal to craft a Wicked Sun Brooch and bring it to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.

records.name: Shipment: Intricate Bone Figurine
records.objectives_text: Combine a Proto Dragon Bone, a Sun Crystal and a Dark Jade to craft an :Intricate Bone Figurine and bring it to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.

records.name: Shipment: Bright Armor Relic
records.objectives_text: Combine an :Elemental Armor Scrap, a :Bloodstone and a :Huge Citrine to craft a Bright Armor Relic and bring it to Timothy Jones in Dalaran. You can find an Elemental Armor Scrap on any Northrend Revenant.

records.name: Shipment: Shifting Sun Curio
records.objectives_text: Combine a Scourge Curio, a Sun Crystal and a Shadow Crystal to craft a :Shifting Sun Curio and bring it to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.

records.name: The Dark Ore
records.objectives_text: Bring 5 Ore Samples to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Relief for the Fallen & Fighting Back

records.name: The Gifts of Loken
records.objectives_text: Destroy Loken's Fury, Loken's Power, and Loken's Favor, and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Slaves of the Stormforged & The Dark Ore

records.name: You Can't Miss Him
records.objectives_text: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to find Njormeld at Fjorn's Anvil.

records.name: Battling the Elements
records.objectives_text: Njormeld wants you to accompany Snorri to Fjorn's anvil and help him kill 10 Seething Revenants.

records.name: Yulda's Folly
records.objectives_text: Iva the Vengeful at Brunnhildar Village wants you to slay Yulda the Stormspeaker in Valkyrion.

records.name: Is That Your Goblin?
records.objectives_text: Challenge Agnetta Tyrsdottar in order to save Zeev Fizzlespark. Return to Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village after you've succeeded.

records.name: The Hyldsmeet
records.objectives_text: Listen to Lok'lira the Crone's proposal.

records.name: Taking on All Challengers
records.objectives_text: Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village wants you to defeat 6 Victorious Challengers.

records.name: You'll Need a Bear
records.objectives_text: Speak to Brijana outside Brunnhildar Village.

records.name: The Brothers Bronzebeard
records.objectives_text: Accompany Brann Bronzebeard and his flying machine to Frosthold.

records.name: The Champion's Call!
records.objectives_text: Seek out Gurgthock at the Amphitheater of Anguish in Zul'Drak.

records.name: In Memoriam
records.objectives_text: King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem wants you to collect 8 Horn Fragments from Thunderfall.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Krolmir, Hammer of Storms

records.name: A Monument to the Fallen
records.objectives_text: King Jokkum wants you to bring Hodir's Horn Fragments to Njormeld in Dun Niffelem.

prerequisites.wiki_text: In Memoriam

records.name: Hodir's Call
records.objectives_text: You are to defeat 5 Niffelem Forefathers and 5 Restless Frostborn at Thunderfall. You are then to blow Hodir's Horn over their corpses, then return to :Hodir's Horn in Dun Niffelem.

records.name: Facing the Storm
records.objectives_text: Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to kill 10 Nidavelir Stormforged. You may kill Stormforged Champions, Stormforged Magi, or Stormforged War Golems.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Slaves of the Stormforged & The Dark Ore

records.name: Armor of Darkness
records.objectives_text: Bring 4 Dark Armor Samples to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

prerequisites.wiki_text: The Gifts of Loken & Facing the Storm

records.name: The Armor's Secrets
records.objectives_text: Take the Dark Armor Plate to Mimir's Workshop and ask Attendant Tock to examine it. When you're finished, return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

records.name: Hot and Cold
records.objectives_text: You are to go to Frostfield Lake, kill the Brittle Revenants there and use the Essence of Ice on the Smoldering Scraps at Fjorn's Anvil. You are then to collect 6 of the Frozen Iron scraps and return to Fjorn's Anvil in Dun Niffelem.

records.name: Ebon Blade Prisoners
records.objectives_text: Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault wants you to free 8 Ebon Blade Prisoners. They can be found in the cages throughout the greater Jotunheim region.

records.name: The Last of Her Kind
records.objectives_text: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to rescue an Icemaw Matriarch in the Hibernal Cavern.

records.name: Valduran the Stormborn
records.objectives_text: Use Bouldercrag's War Horn when you have found Valduran the Stormborn. Defeat Valduran the Stormborn and return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

records.name: Forging a Head
records.objectives_text: Njormeld in Dun Niffelem needs you to use the Diamond Tipped Pick on the Dead Iron Giants at Frostfield Lake and return to him when you have collected 8 Stormforged Eyes.

records.name: Fate of the Titans
records.objectives_text: Creteus in the Foot Steppes has requests that you travel to the Temple of Invention, the Temple of Winter, the Temple of Life, and the Temple of Order and utilize the databank to examine each area.

records.name: Placing Hodir's Helm
records.objectives_text: Njormeld wants you to fly to the tip of the northern ice spike in Dun Niffelem and use the Tablets of Pronouncement.

records.name: Destroy the Forges!
records.objectives_text: Destroy the North Lightning Forge, the Central Lightning Forge, and the South Lightning Forge with Bouldercrag's Bombs, then return to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Valduran the Stormborn

records.name: The Slithering Darkness
records.objectives_text: Astrid Bjornrittar wants you to slay 8 Ravenous Jormungar in the Hibernal Cavern east of Brunnhildar Village.

records.name: Hit Them Where it Hurts
records.objectives_text: Kill 10 Stormforged Artificers and return to Bruor Ironbane at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Valduran the Stormborn

records.name: Crush Dem Vrykuls!
records.objectives_text: Vile at The Shadow Vault wants you to slay any 15 vrykul in the greater Jotunheim region.

records.name: A Colossal Threat
records.objectives_text: Retrieve the Colossus Attack Specs and Colossus Defense Specs and bring them to Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge.

prerequisites.wiki_text: Destroy the Forges! & Hit Them Where it Hurts

records.name: Spy Hunter
records.objectives_text: You must defeat 3 Stormforged Spies in the Valley of Ancient Winters. Using the Ethereal Worg's Fang at the Corpse of the Fallen Worg will summon an Ethereal Frostworg, which will expose hidden enemies. You are to return to the Frostworg Denmother in Dun Niffelem when the valley has been cleansed of spies.

records.name: Leave Our Mark
records.objectives_text: Baron Sliver at The Shadow Vault wishes you to plant 15 Ebon Blade Banners within the corpses of vrykul found within the greater Jotunheim region.

objectives.text: Vrykul corpses impaled with Ebon Blade banners (15)

records.name: The Warm-Up
records.objectives_text: Astrid Bjornrittar in Brunnhildar Village wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch (Brunnhildar Village) to defeat Kirgaraak.

records.name: Into the Pit
records.objectives_text: Astrid Bjornrittar, in Brunnhildar Village, wants you to use the Reins of the Warbear Matriarch (Brunnhildar Village) inside the Pit of the Fang and defeat 6 Hyldsmeet Warbears.

records.name: The Heart of the Storm
records.objectives_text: Bouldercrag the Rockshaper at Bouldercrag's Refuge wants you to travel to Uldis and try to prevent Overseer Narvir from obtaining the Heart of the Storm.

objectives.text: Try to find the Heart of the Storm before Overseer Narvir does

records.name: The Bone Witch
records.objectives_text: Speak with The Bone Witch within the cave at Njorndar Village.
